theater: 隴右安定郡臨洮與華亭一帶

battle.name: 荔非世雄起義
battle.theater: 隴右安定郡臨洮與華亭一帶
battle.brief: 大業十二年（616）九月初九，安定郡人荔非世雄在臨洮縣聚眾，殺縣令、自稱將軍，隴右的郡縣秩序隨之斷裂。卡面這件秦弩正是亂局中守城的關鍵：弩機儲力、一張一發，郡兵居高臨下把攻城的鄉兵壓在牆外；只是募兵、屯田戶與流民大量流散，守軍的弩陣與糧道都撐不了多久。

kit.name: 秦弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，射速遠勝拉弓。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方是隋朝官軍與以荔非世雄為首的隴右起義軍。隋朝此時仍是東亞最大的帝國，但大業朝的行軍體系已被抽空：兵部掌符節與軍令，郡縣以太守、令領郡兵，邊郡另置屯田、烽燧與亭障，大業十一年天下募兵與郡兵混編成為主力，府兵編制早已名存實亡。官軍一端以安定郡為樞紐：郡治安定縣領安定、臨洮、華亭三縣，郡兵駐在縣城，城頭備弩，倉儲供郡兵與屯田戶口糧，烽燧沿涇水與隴山東麓串聯涇州、秦州與涼州。起義一端沒有可考的建制與將領體系，荔非世雄只以「將軍」自號，所部是聚在鄉里的農民、逃戶、失去戶籍的屯田戶與邊地氐、羌部眾，多備耕獵器具改成的叉、梃、耙、鐮而少有甲胄。這場起義與同年雁門的翟松柏、泗州的孫華、高陽的趙萬海、太原的甄翟兒、鄱陽與廬陵的操師乞等事並發，說明亂事已由個別郡縣擴散成全國性的崩解。
countriesEn: The two sides in this conflict were the government troops of the Sui dynasty and the Longxi rebel army led by Li Fei Shixiong. Sui was still the largest state in East Asia at the time, but the military system of the Daye era had been hollowed out: the Ministry of War held the tally and the orders, commanderies and counties fielded their local troops through the governors and magistrates, and frontier commanderies maintained farms, beacon towers and barrier forts on their own. From the eleventh year of Daye, recruited volunteers mixed in with local troops became the main force, while the fubing system of the Northern Zhou had long since existed in name only. On the government side, Anding commandery was the hinge of the whole operation: its seat at Anding county governed three counties, Anding, Lintao and Huating; the local garrison was quartered in the county towns, crossbows were kept on the walls, the granaries fed the soldiers and the farm households, and a chain of beacon towers along the Jing river and the eastern foot of the Long mountains linked the commandery to Jingzhou, Qinzhou and Liangzhou. On the rebel side there was no documented organisation and no chain of command at all: Li Fei Shixiong styled himself merely a general, and his followers were peasants, runaways, farm households who had lost their registration, and Di and Qiang groups from the frontier, most of them armed with prongs, clubs, rakes and sickles adapted from farming and hunting tools and very poorly supplied with armour. This rising broke out in the same year as Zhai Songbai at Yanmen, Sun Hua at Sizhou, Zhao Wanhai at Gaoyang, Zhen Di'er at Taiyuan, and Cao Shiqi and Lin Shihong in the Poyang and Luling area, which shows that the disorder had spread from isolated commanderies into a nationwide collapse.
people: 荔非世雄是安定郡本地人，姓氏「荔非」自魏晉以來見於涼州將吏，為氐人舊姓，安定郡一帶羌、氐、漢雜居，他的號令在鄉里與部族中都吃得開。起事當日他以將軍自居，殺死臨洮縣令，隨即聚眾據縣城；被殺的縣令姓名不傳，郡守與郡兵將校的名字在現存史文中也沒有留下，說明這場戰事在當時只被簡略記為「郡縣之亂」，並非朝廷矚目的大役。直接參與者有兩類：一是臨洮、安定一帶的鄉民、逃戶與失去土地的屯田戶；二是被官府徵發遠征遼東、久滯不歸的戍卒與逃兵。朝廷一端，隋煬帝大業十二年仍在河北涿郡一線主持遼東軍事，只能以詔令令附近州郡自行討平，兵部發下的符節與糧械要經長安再轉隴右，路上往往數月。同期在雁門起兵的翟松柏、在泗州起兵的孫華、在高陽起兵的趙萬海、在太原起兵的甄翟兒，以及在鄱陽、廬陵起兵的操師乞與林士弘，都說明中央已無力對每一處同時用兵，救火只能靠鄰郡的守將與臨時徵集的鄉兵。
peopleEn: Li Fei Shixiong was a native of Anding commandery. The surname Liffei had appeared among the officers of Liangzhou since the Wei and Jin dynasties and was an old Di clan name, and in Anding commandery the Di, the Qiang and the Han lived side by side, so his authority carried weight both among the village households and among the tribal groups. On the very day the rising began he styled himself a general, killed the magistrate of Lintao, and gathered a crowd to hold the county seat. The name of the slain magistrate has not been preserved, and neither have those of the commandery governor or the officers of the local garrison, which shows that at the time the affair was recorded only briefly as a disturbance of a commandery and county, not as a major campaign of interest to the court. Two kinds of people took part directly. First were the villagers, runaways and farm households who had lost their land around Lintao and Anding. Second were soldiers and deserters conscripted for the campaigns in Liaodong who had been away for years and never came back. On the court side, the Sui emperor was still in the Hebei region around Zhuojun in the twelfth year of Daye, personally directing the Liaodong war, and could only issue edicts ordering the neighbouring prefectures to suppress the rising on their own; the tallies and grain and weapons dispatched by the Ministry of War had to travel from Chang'an to Longxi and often took months to arrive. The simultaneous risings of Zhai Songbai at Yanmen, Sun Hua at Sizhou, Zhao Wanhai at Gaoyang, Zhen Di'er at Taiyuan, and Cao Shiqi and Lin Shihong around Poyang and Luling all show that the centre could no longer send troops to every rising at once, and each fire had to be fought by the neighbouring garrisons and by hastily levied villagers. In the twelfth year of Daye the emperor was still waging war in Liaodong, and much of the Longxi garrison had been sent north, so the county towns were thinly held; once the villagers had gathered into a crowd, no magistrate, however resolute, could hold a town single-handed.
kits: 卡面這件秦弩是弩的源頭形態：弩機先把拉力存進機括，上弦之後不必再拉弓，瞄準、等待、放弦三個動作分開，射程與精度都勝過手持弓。隋代隴右郡兵所用的蹶張弩、立弩與腰開弩都出於同一機制，只是把上弦改得更省力、弩機做得更精巧；居延與敦煌的漢簡裏，「具弩」與配套的矢、楬是亭障與烽燧的常備之物，數量以數十張弩、千計的矢為度，可見弩在邊防體系中的份量。攻城一方則沒有弩：起義眾多持弓、矛、鎬、梃、梯、繩索與農具，攻牆靠蟻附、穴地、撞門與火燒門樓。守方除弩之外還有環首刀、長槊、札甲與明光鎧、檑、旌旗與鼓角；後勤靠關中與隴右的屯田、驛馬與糧車供給，糧道一斷，弩陣再穩也撐不了多久。弩在隋代是成套配發的軍需：郡兵出發前到州縣武庫領取弩機、矢與甲仗，武庫負責弩的儲存與修配，漢簡所見「楬」「承弓」與弩矢的配套記錄，正說明它不是個人自備的獵具，而是列在軍籍之上的裝備。
kitsEn: The Chinese crossbow on the card is the ancestral form of the weapon. The trigger mechanism stores the pull in the lock first, so once the bowstring is drawn the archer no longer has to hold the draw; aiming, waiting and releasing become three separate actions, and both range and accuracy beat a hand bow. The crossbows of the Sui local garrisons in Longxi, the strongman-drawn crossbow, the standing crossbow and the waist-cocked crossbow, all grew out of the same mechanism, differing only in that cocking was made easier and the locks more refined. In the Han wooden slips from Juyan and Dunhuang, the strung crossbow and its bolts and bolts-tally appear as standard stock of the barrier forts and beacon towers, recorded in tens of crossbows and bolts by the thousand, which shows the weight of the crossbow within the frontier defence system. The besiegers had no crossbow at all. The rebels carried bows, spears, mattocks, clubs, ladders, ropes and farm tools, and attacked walls by swarming up them, mining under them, battering the gates and setting fire to the gate towers. On the defending side, beyond the crossbows, there were ring-pommel sabres, long spears, lamellar and mirror-bright plate armour, mantlets, banners, drums and horns. Logistics rested on the farms, relay horses and grain carts of Guanzhong and Longxi, and once the supply line was cut no crossbow line could hold for long. The crossbow was issued in sets as army equipment in the Sui: before a detachment marched out, the local troops drew crossbow locks, bolts and armour from the commandery or county arsenal, whose task was the storage and repair of the weapon. The Han slips that record tally sticks, bow cases and bolts in matched sets show that it was not a hunting tool carried privately but kit listed on the muster roll.
tactics: 起義的步驟是先聚眾、再奪縣、然後威脅郡治：荔非世雄在臨洮縣聚眾當日即殺縣令奪城，隨後把鄉兵分成數股，一部隨他威逼郡治安定縣，一部向華亭與鄰近縣份擴散，靠人數與突然性迫使郡兵退守城垣。攻城沒有大型器械，主要用蟻附、穴地、撞門與夜間襲擊門樓、焚燒守軍堆放的柴草與糧車；鄉民多不習陣，只能倚靠人多、靠攢猛衝與四面散射的弓矢。起義眾還常挾帶鄉里的糧、畜與器具轉戰，隊伍不整、紀律鬆散，遇敗即散為盜，復合又成兵，這與成建制的郡兵守城恰成對照。官軍的守法是把弩手分層布於城頭與門樓，交叉射擊壓制城下人群，再用檑、拒馬與落石守住缺口；出城則以精騎掃蕩、斷其糧道、派偵騎監視，郡兵不足時再向涇州、秦州與京師方向請援，烽燧逐級傳警。隴右冬季苦寒、糧道修長，遠征在外的兵卒與屯田戶早已斷絕，攻防兩端都靠倉中存糧度日，一旦遇上雪封山道，戰局就會僵持下去。
tacticsEn: The sequence of the rising was to gather a crowd, seize the county, and then threaten the commandery seat. On the day the crowd assembled in Lintao county, Li Fei Shixiong killed the magistrate and took the town; he then split his villagers into several bodies, one following him against the commandery seat at Anding, others spreading toward Huating and the neighbouring counties, relying on numbers and surprise to force the local garrison back behind its walls. There were no heavy engines for the assault. The main methods were swarming up the walls, mining beneath them, battering the gates, and striking the gate towers at night to burn the firewood and grain carts stacked inside. The villagers had little drill, so they could only rely on their numbers, on pushing in a mass and on loosing arrows in every direction. The rebels also moved with the grain, cattle and utensils they could carry off from the villages, and their columns were ragged and their discipline loose: beaten, they scattered as bandits, and gathered again they were an army once more, which is the exact opposite of the ordered garrison that defended the towns. The government defence was to post crossbowmen in layers along the walls and gate towers so that their fire crossed over the crowds below, then to hold the breaches with mantlets, cheval-de-frise and stones dropped from above. Any sortie went out with picked cavalry to sweep the country, cut the grain road and shadow the rebels with scouts, and when the local garrison was too thin they called for help from Jingzhou, Qinzhou and the capital, with the beacon towers passing the alarm stage by stage. Winter in Longxi is bitter and the supply road is long, and the soldiers away on campaign and the farm households had long since cut their ties to the land, so both sides lived on what was in the granaries; once the snow sealed the mountain tracks, the contest froze into a stalemate.
data: 可核的數字不多，但有據可依：起事記在大業十二年九月初九（戊戌日）；隋安定郡治安定縣，領安定、臨洮、華亭三縣，郡治至臨洮縣不足百里，騎馬一日可達；弩的射程一般被認為在百步上下，強蹶張弩可及二百步，一張普通弩的上弦與再上弦需時數十息，因此守方靠交替掩蔽維持射擊密度；漢代亭障的簡牘所記具弩常以數十張為一組，配套的矢以千計。背景數字也清楚：大業八年征高句麗，天下之兵百十三萬，糧資器械倍之，隴右、河東、江淮的丁壯大批沒於遼東；大業五年西巡張掖與焉支山，士卒凍餓死者以萬計。至於起義眾數、官軍出動人數、交兵次數與雙方損耗，現存史文都沒有確數可考，只能以「聚眾」「殺縣令」「自稱將軍」這類記載為界。可以確定的距離與時間尺度是：郡治安定縣至臨洮縣不足百里，驛傳一日可達；隴右的烽燧逐級傳警，沿線各亭障之間的傳訊距離也以一兩日行程為限。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are few, but they are solid. The rising is dated to the ninth day of the ninth month of the twelfth year of Daye, the day Wuxu. Anding commandery of the Sui had its seat at Anding county and governed three counties, Anding, Lintao and Huating, and the distance from the commandery seat to Lintao county was under one hundred li, a single day's ride. A crossbow is generally held to have a range of about a hundred paces, with a powerful strongman-drawn crossbow reaching two hundred paces, and cocking and re-cocking an ordinary crossbow took several tens of breaths, so the defenders had to alternate behind cover to keep up the rate of fire; Han slips from the barrier forts record strung crossbows in groups of tens, matched by bolts by the thousand. The background figures are also plain. In the eighth year of Daye the campaign against Goguryeo raised one million one hundred and thirty thousand men from across the empire, with grain and equipment to match, and large numbers of the liable men of Longxi, Hedong and the Jiang-Huai region never came back from Liaodong. In the fifth year of Daye the western tour reached Zhangye and Yanzhi Mountain, where soldiers froze and starved to death in the tens of thousands. As for the size of the rebel force, the number of government troops sent out, the number of engagements and the losses on both sides, no reliable figures survive in the historical record; the only bounds are the recorded acts of gathering a crowd, killing the magistrate and styling oneself a general. The distances and intervals that can be fixed are these: the commandery seat at Anding county lay under one hundred li from Lintao, a single day's ride by the relay service, and the beacon towers of Longxi passed the alarm in stages, so the reporting distance between one barrier fort and the next was measured in one or two days' travel.
cause: 大業年間的隴右，兵役、徭役與天災同時壓下來。開皇以來關中與隴右的丁壯被大批徵發：先有西巡張掖、焉支山的長途轉運，再有征高句麗的傾國之役，出征者多不能歸，家中失去男丁，田地無人耕種；關中饑荒與逃戶潮又使大量流民湧入隴右山地，而當地的屯田戶在軍籍與逃戶的夾縫中逃亡，郡縣的戶口簿籍早已失真，賦役無從征斂，官府轉而加派，亂上加亂。荔非世雄起兵的直接契機是縣吏催科與聚眾的衝突釀成殺官，隨即擴為佔縣、號令鄉里的武裝行動；華亭、涇川一帶羌、氐部眾素有邊地武風，氐姓首領一呼，同族、姻親與依附的屯田戶跟從者眾。隋廷對邊郡的羈縻與屯田管理原本嚴密，一旦郡兵被抽調、縣令失人心，最先被點燃的就是這種邊地社會。大業十二年隋煬帝仍在遼東用兵，隴右郡兵多已調往北方，縣城守備空虛，鄉民一旦聚集成眾，縣令再強也難以獨力抵禦。
causeEn: In Longxi during the Daye era, military service, forced labour and natural disaster all pressed down at once. Since the Kaihuang reign the liable men of Guanzhong and Longxi had been conscripted in great numbers: first the long haul of the western tour to Zhangye and Yanzhi Mountain, then the war of national exhaustion against Goguryeo, in which so many never returned, leaving households without a man to work the fields. Famine in Guanzhong and a tide of runaways pushed masses of displaced people into the mountains of Longxi, while the farm households there slipped away between the military registers and the flight of registered persons, so the household books of the commanderies and counties had long since become fiction, the taxes and levies could no longer be gathered, and the offices simply added new levies, compounding the disorder. The immediate trigger for Li Fei Shixiong's rising was a clash between county officials pressing for payment and the crowd he had gathered, which turned into the killing of the magistrate and then expanded into an armed seizure of the county and a call to arms among the villagers. The Di and Qiang populations around Huating and Jingchuan had always had the martial habits of the frontier, and when a chief of the Di surname called, kindred, marriage allies and dependent farm households followed in numbers. The court's oversight of the frontier commanderies through hostages and farms had been strict enough, but once the garrisons were pulled away and the magistrates lost the trust of the people, it was this frontier society that ignited first.
impact: 這場起義的直接影響在隴右：安定郡的縣城與郡治一度脫離朝廷控制，郡兵、屯田與驛傳系統被打斷，關中通往河西走廊的西面屏障出現缺口。此後一年，張掖的李軌與王國寶再舉義旗、割據河西，涼州、甘州與肅州的門戶洞開，隋廷已無力西顧；唐初李淵入關中時，隴右已是由無數小股武裝分割的局面，平定隴右成建國初期最費時的戰役之一。對當地編戶齊民而言，這意味著戶籍、徭役與田冊重歸無序；隴右的戶口要在隋唐易代之後重新統計編造，往後多年仍是唐初括戶的主要對象。制度層面，它加速了隋朝軍制的崩壞：募兵與郡兵混編而無訓練、屯田戶逃亡而府兵不復，國家失去一支可以隨時召集的兵，鎮守地方的郡兵只能臨時徵集，戰爭因此變成小規模、曠日持久的消耗。邊防上的後果同樣具體：隴右空虛，吐谷渾與吐蕃的壓力隨之加重，唐初不得不設軍、屯田、修隴右通道來補這道口子。
impactEn: The immediate effect of this rising was felt in Longxi. The county towns and the commandery seat of Anding fell out of court control for a time; the local garrison, the farm system and the relay service were all broken, and a gap opened in the western screen that guarded Guanzhong from the Hexi corridor. A year later Li Gui and Wang Guobao raised the banner again at Zhangye and carved out a power in Hexi, the gates of Liangzhou, Ganzhou and Suzhou stood wide, and the Sui court had no strength left to look west. When Li Yuan entered Guanzhong at the beginning of the Tang, Longxi was already carved up by a number of small armed bands, and the pacification of Longxi became one of the longest campaigns of the early Tang. For the people of the region it meant that registers, levies and land books fell out of order again; the population of Longxi had to be counted and written anew after the change of dynasty, and for years afterwards it remained a main target of the early Tang's household registration drives. At the level of institutions, the rising hastened the breakdown of the Sui military system: volunteers and local troops were mixed without training, farm households fled and the fubing did not return, the state lost the force it could call on at any moment, and the commanderies could only improvise levies for local defence, so war turned into small-scale and protracted attrition. The frontier consequences were just as concrete. With Longxi hollowed out, the pressure of Tuyuhun and of Tibet increased, and the early Tang had to establish armies, farms and roads in Longxi to mend the breach.
result: 結果要分兩層說：軍事上，荔非世雄確實拿下了臨洮縣、殺了縣令、自稱將軍，安定郡的官軍一度退守郡治與城垣，隴右的官府秩序被打斷；但他沒有自立王號，也沒有佔據跨州的大城，更沒有建立可以持續的政權與賦役，現存史文沒有留下他後來活動的可靠記錄，下落如何、終於何時被平，史籍所記的結局只到「郡縣陷落、官軍退保」為止。朝廷一端照例下詔令附近州郡發兵討平，並派使者往來長安與隴右，但具體由誰領兵、交兵幾次、荔非世雄是死於亂軍還是在隨後的清剿中被擒，正史都沒有可考的記載，於是這場戰事成了隋末「記載有限但確有其事」的典型事件之一。可以確定的是：這場起義沒有改寫北方的格局，卻是隋朝在隴右崩解的一環；兩年後關中易主時，郡縣與人口都已經破碎，後來收拾這段殘局的人不是隋廷，而是唐初的軍府與鎮守使。
resultEn: The outcome has to be taken in two layers. Militarily, Li Fei Shixiong did take Lintao county, did kill the magistrate, did style himself a general, and the government troops of Anding commandery did fall back for a time behind the commandery seat and its walls, breaking the administrative order of Longxi. But he never assumed a royal title, never occupied a major city across more than one prefecture, and never built a state with a revenue system that could sustain itself. No reliable record of his later movements survives, and the historical text carries the story only as far as the county falling and the government troops falling back. On the court side the usual edict went out ordering the neighbouring prefectures to raise troops and suppress the rising, and envoys travelled between Chang'an and Longxi, but who led the troops, how many times the two sides actually met, and whether Li Fei Shixiong died in the fighting or was taken in the later clean-up are all beyond what the official histories record. The affair is therefore a typical example of the late Sui, something that certainly happened but is only thinly documented. What can be said with certainty is this: the rising did not reshape the balance of power in the north, but it was one part of the Sui collapse in Longxi, and by the time the capital changed hands in Guanzhong two years later, the commanderies and their populations were already broken; the men who finally gathered up the pieces were not Sui officials but the military districts and garrison commanders of the early Tang.
